title: A listing file: what `kontra publish <listing.yaml>` sends to the operator's control plane (D323)
description: How one of the publisher's A2A services is listed, as Kontra Cloud's PUT /v1/services/{name} takes it (kontra-cloud D-M5-95, D-M5-110): its visibility, sealing, state and task timeout. Listings are A2A only: an MCP service is not listed, and the control plane refuses a listing for one (D350). A listing has no price: a seller that charges declares AP2 in its agent card, and neither the gate nor the CLI holds an amount (D351). The file is YAML (or JSON). The CLI checks the file against this schema and sends it; the control plane decides what it accepts.

service.description: The service's name at the gate, under the publisher's tenant: 1 to 63 of [a-z0-9-], not starting or ending with '-'.

visibility.description: public: listed and searched; unlisted: reachable by its URL, never searched (relay.md §12.2, D321); private: the publisher's own tenant only.

published.description: false unpublishes the service (the gate answers it as unknown) and keeps the listing as a new version.

taskTimeoutSeconds.description: The service's task.timeout, which the control plane writes (relay.md §6.5): how long a task may run before the gate fails it.
